repositories.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

repositories.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

repositories.description: Agent workspace built on Cloudflare Workers for creating documents, building apps, and running agents with your company’s context and systems.
repositories.description_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 agent 工作区，用于创建文档、构建应用，并结合企业上下文和系统运行 agents。

repositories.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
